text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices

No. 1924/47 – FRIDAY, JUJY 24, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT)ACT, No. 28 OF 1964
(Notice under Section 7)
My Reference No.: 3/2/3/10/249.

I hereby give notice, under Sub section (1) of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for the construction of Water Treatment Plant under the Gampaha Attanagalla, Minuvangoda Integrated Water Supply Project.

Description of the Land to be acquired: An allotments of land the name and extent mentioned below depicted to preliminary plan No. Gam. 3956 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the Village of Karasnagala in Grama Niladhari Division of No. 365 C Karasnagala (South) in the Divisional Secretaries Division of Attanagalla in Gampaha District Western Province.
1. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Dammullahena; Description: Open Waste Land with well; Claimant: State; Previouse Claimant: Land Reform Commission; Extent: 1.2056 Hectare.
All persons interested in the aforesaid land is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by

agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat Attanagalla on the 26th day of August 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 19th day of August 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
D. M. RATHNAYAKE, Divisional Secretary, Attanagalla. Divisional Secretariat, Attanagalla. 20th July, 2015. 08 –235

Description of the Land to be acquired: An allotment of land the name and extent mentioned below depicted to preliminary plan No. Gam. 3498 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the Village of Sapugastenna in Garama Niladhari Division of No. 365B Sapugastenna in the Divisional Secretaries Division of Attanagalla in Gampaha District Western Province.

1. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Haliyamadapurana alias Moraattupalla; Description: Open Waste Land ; Claimant: State; Previous Claimant: Mangalika Fernando No. 79A Nikahetikanda, K. Rathnathilaka, No. 82A Haliyamada, Sapugastenna, Nikahetikanda, N. Wimaladasa, No. 160, Moraathula, Sapugastenna, W. Ariyarathne, No. 84, Haliyamada, Sapugastenna, Nikahetikanda; Extent: 0.3940 Hectare.

D. M. RATHNAYAKE, Divisional Secretary, Attanagalla. Divisional Secretariat, Attanagalla. 20th July, 2015.
